LET'S EXPLORE

Fishing is more than catching fish!

From your very first cast to identifying a fish, discover how fishing builds patience, confidence, curiosity and a love of the outdoors.

Fishing 101

Get to know rods and reels, learn to cast, practise handling tackle and discover how to fish with care. Every beginner starts somewhere!

Safety Superstars

Find out how to choose a safe spot, look after your mates, respect the water and ask an adult before handling hooks.

Meet familiar fish found in NSW waters. Learn how to identify them, measure your catch and understand why fishing rules matter.

OUR FISHING PROMISE

Four steps to a great day out

🧑‍🤝‍🧑

1. Bring an adult

Kids fish with a responsible adult or appropriately supervised group.

🛟

2. Stay safe

Keep away from slippery edges and wear suitable safety gear.

📏

3. Check your catch

Identify your fish and follow current size and bag limits.

💚

4. Care for nature

Take litter home and handle fish gently and respectfully.

MEET ALEX

A fishing adventure with Alex 👋

Fishing is a chance to slow down, try something new and share the excitement of being outside. This club concept is about turning those first fishing moments into fun, memorable learning experiences.

We want young anglers to feel welcome as they explore fishing basics, recognise local species, practise safe habits and learn why protecting our waterways is so important.

  • Friendly learning for first-time fishers
  • Hands-on outdoor experiences
  • Respect for fish, wildlife and the environment

Draft introduction for review: Alex can add his own fishing story, experience and approach to teaching before the website goes live.
